method: static only: fields and their last sighting are machine-read from E388's published face; a site is any .py under the repo that mentions 'trial_labor'; a row needs a string literal whose value IS a dropped field, classified by its AST parent (subscript/getter = read, dict key = write, keyword selector = declared, otherwise mention); the wave is known only when the whole file carries exactly one trial_labor_w<N> literal, otherwise indeterminate; a family glob can never resolve its wave
